caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a dark brown, metallic glove or gauntlet with articulated segments for the fingers, thumb, and wrist. Attached at the wrist end of the glove is a spiked circular mechanism resembling a medieval spur, which features six evenly spaced spokes radiating out from a central hub. The glove includes buckled straps on the wrist and back of the hand sections. The material has a textured appearance, and shading is used to suggest volume and contours. There is an artist's signature in small, cursive writing beneath the object on the right side of the drawing.
title: Spur
